name: Data Converter
description: Convert anything in one DBX workbench panel: 13 formats (JSON / YAML / XML / Properties / TOML / INI / .env / CSV / TSV / Query / Headers / Cookie / HTML) in any combination, JSONPath / jq queries with JSON Schema validation, eight escape tools (URL / Base64 / HTML / JSON / Unicode / Hex / SQL / Regex), batch text to SQL (IN / NOT IN / INSERT), .xlsx / .csv / .tsv to JSON, Image ⇄ Base64, and a Byte Converter (B/KB/MB/GB/TB/PB on both the 1000 and 1024 scales, exact ⇄ human readable, batch totals, plus hex dump / byte array / binary string). A Time Converter turns timestamps and dates into each other (local, T-separated, UTC, ISO 8601 and relative) one value per line, with foldable results and copies that carry results only. A Code Gen page turns a JSON sample or a CREATE TABLE into TypeScript / Go / Java / Python models, and a Chart page renders an ECharts option (or bare numbers) as a real chart, 700 x 400 by default with custom width and height, exported as PNG or SVG. Pure frontend, no backend, works offline.
releaseNotes: Your navigation can now live on the left. A layout button at the far right of the top bar moves the ten navigation entries into a vertical column (13rem wide) and hands the content area the same space back; click again to return to the top, which stays the default. On the left the top bar keeps only the brand, the language switcher and this button; the format-convert picker moves to the top of the column and expands inside it, pushing the entries down instead of floating over them. The vertical column fits every entry, so "More" no longer appears. Your choice is remembered across reloads and app restarts through the host plugin storage (the workbench sandbox has an opaque origin, so localStorage is not available there); when the host cannot store it, the plugin falls back to browser localStorage and then to window.name, which is the only channel that survives inside the dbx-plugin dev sandbox (localStorage, sessionStorage and cookies all throw there). A small fix rides along: navigation entries are 2.4px tighter on each side, so all ten still fit a 1440-wide window now that the button is there. All eleven pages stay translated into 14 languages, and everything still runs locally: no network, no eval.

zh-CN.name: 数据转换
zh-CN.description: 在 DBX 工作台里一次转完：JSON / YAML / XML / Properties / TOML / INI / .env / CSV / TSV / Query / Headers / Cookie / HTML 共 13 种格式任意互转、JSONPath / jq 查询与 JSON Schema 校验（含从样例反推 Schema）、URL / Base64 / HTML / JSON / Unicode / Hex / SQL / 正则 8 种转义互转、字节换算（B / KB / MB / GB / TB / PB，1000 与 1024 两套进制，精确值 ⇄ 人类可读，批量求和，以及 hex dump / 字节数组 / 二进制串）、批量文本生成 SQL（IN / NOT IN / INSERT）、.xlsx / .csv / .tsv 转 JSON，以及图片 ↔ Base64；「代码生成」页把一段 JSON 示例或一条 CREATE TABLE 直接变成 TypeScript / Go / Java / Python 模型；「JSON 转图表」页把一段 ECharts option（或一组数字）直接画成图，默认 700 × 400、宽高可改，可导出 PNG / SVG；「时间转换」页把时间戳与日期批量互转（本地时间 / `T` 分隔 / UTC / ISO 8601 / 相对时间任选，结果可折叠、可单个复制）。纯前端、无后端、可离线运行。
